summary: The Prison Staff Safety Enhancement Act requires the Department of Justice and the Federal Bureau of Prisons to address and prevent sexual harassment and sexual assault committed by incarcerated individuals against prison staff. It mandates full implementation of past Inspector General recommendations, updated data collection, analysis by the Inspector General, and new national standards promulgated by the Attorney General.

affected_groups.effect: Will receive increased protections through new national standards, improved data collection on safety threats, and the implementation of mitigation strategies for workplace safety.
affected_groups.group: Bureau of Prisons Employees and Correctional Officers

affected_groups.effect: Subject to national standards and punishments regarding sexual harassment and sexual assault perpetrated against prison staff.
Must perform data analyses, receive reports, and promulgate new rules and national standards according to strict deadlines.
affected_groups.group: Department of Justice and Inspector General

key_provisions: The Bureau of Prisons must fully implement all recommendations from the 2023 Inspector General report on inmate-on-staff sexual harassment and assault within 90 days of enactment, or submit an explanation and timeline to Congress.

The Inspector General must request and analyze updated data from the Bureau on fiscal years 2022 through 2025 regarding sexual harassment and assault incidents within one year of the Bureau implementing the recommendations.
The Inspector General must provide Congress and the Attorney General with an analysis of these incidents, including an evaluation of past punishments used in Bureau facilities.

The Attorney General must promulgate a rule adopting national standards for the prevention, reduction, and punishment of sexual harassment and assault of staff by incarcerated individuals within one year of receiving the Inspector General's analysis.
missing_information: Specific funding amounts or budgetary appropriations allocated to carry out these requirements are not mentioned.
Specific details or text of the national standards to be promulgated by the Attorney General are not provided in advance.
summary_detail.plain_summary: The Prison Staff Safety Enhancement Act requires the Department of Justice and the Federal Bureau of Prisons to address and prevent sexual harassment and sexual assault committed by incarcerated individuals against prison staff. It mandates full implementation of past Inspector General recommendations, updated data collection, analysis by the Inspector General, and new national standards promulgated by the Attorney General.
summary_detail.significance: The law directly alters how the Federal Bureau of Prisons and the Department of Justice track, evaluate, and punish inmate-on-staff sexual harassment and assault, shifting from previously inadequate data collection and mitigation strategies to mandated nationwide standards and oversight.
